On November 3, 2026, IonQ, Inc. (the “ Company ”) completed its previously announced acquisition (the “ Acquisition ”) of all of the issued and outstanding shares of common stock of Elisity, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“ Elisity ”), pursuant to the terms of the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of October 9, 2026, by and among the Company, Elisity, Espresso Acquisition Sub, Inc., a Delaware corporation and a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, and Fortis Advisors LLC, solely in its capacity as the representative of the securityholders (the “ Holder Representative ”). The consideration (the “ Closing Consideration ”) delivered in connection with the closing of the Acquisition consists of 32,233,274 shares of the Company’s common stock, par value $0.0001 per share (each, a “ Share ”). In addition to the Closing Consideration, Elisity’s securityholders will be eligible to receive up to 4,265,934 Shares in earn-out consideration, depending on the achievement of financial metrics through January 2028, which, together with the Closing Consideration, constitutes the merger consideration of up to 36,499,208 Shares (the “ Merger Consideration ”). In connection with the closing of the Acquisition and the issuance of the Merger Consideration, the Company and the Holder Representative entered into a Registration Rights Agreement, dated as of November 3, 2026 (the “ Registration Rights Agreement ”), pursuant to which recipients of the Closing Consideration have certain registration rights with respect thereto. The foregoing description of the Registration Rights Agreement does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the Registration Rights Agreement, a copy of which is filed herewith as Exhibit 10.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated by reference herein. Item 2.02 Results of Operations and Financial Condition. On November 5, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing its financial results for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026. A copy of the press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated herein by reference. Item 3.02 Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities. The information set forth under Item 2.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K related to the Closing Consideration is incorporated herein by reference. The Shares were issued pursuant to one or more exemptions from registration under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “ Securities Act ”), including those provided by Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act and Regulation D and Regulation S promulgated under the Securities Act. Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure. On November 4, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing the closing of the Acquisition. A copy of the press release has been furnished as Exhibit 99.2 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated herein by reference. The information provided pursuant to Item 7.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K, including Exhibit 99.1 hereto, shall not be deemed “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “ Exchange Act ”), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section, nor shall it be deemed incorporated by reference into any of the Company’s filings under the Securities Act or the Exchange Act, except as expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing.
